blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The severe susceptibility of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to hallucinations poses a critical threat to their reliability, making a rigorous evaluation framework indispensable. However, existing evaluation pipelines largely rely on predefined test items, suffering from high construction costs, rapid obsolescence as MLLMs evolve, and ineffectiveness in probing model-specific weaknesses. To address these limitations, we propose SEAM, a self-evolving and adaptive probing framework for automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation. Specifically, SEAM introduces a composable Hallucination Probe Construction Library comprising ten hallucination-probing skills, three elicitation wrappers, and five question formats. Building on this library, SEAM establishes a dual-loop framework. In the inner loop (adaptive probing), skill-guided visual analysis, question composition, and hierarchical quality verification are coordinated with verifier and target-response feedback to refine test items and uncover model-specific hallucinations. In the outer loop (skill evolution), a skill updater distills historical probing trajectories into localized, reusable rule updates, which undergo held-out validation and are frozen before testing. Driven by these innovative structural designs, SEAM establishes an automated and self-evolving evaluation paradigm. Experiments across four target MLLMs and ten hallucination types demonstrate that SEAM substantially outperforms representative static benchmarks, achieving an 89.2\% relative improvement in mean valid hallucination discovery rate across 12 matched comparisons.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)对幻觉的高度易感性对其可靠性构成了严重威胁,因此严格的评价框架是不可或缺的。 然而,现有的评价管道主要依赖预先确定的试验项目,由于建造成本高,随着MLLMs的发展而迅速过时,在检测模型特有的弱点方面效率低下. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立SEAM,作为自动MLLM幻觉评估的自演和适应性的测试框架. 具体地说,SEAM引入了可调和的幻觉探险建筑库,由十种幻觉探险技巧,三道诱导包和五道问题格式组成. 在这个库的基础上,SEAM建立了一个双循环框架. 在内环(适应性检测)中,由技能指导的视觉分析,问题组成,以及分级质量核查与核查器和目标响应反馈相协调,以完善测试项目并发现模型特有的幻觉. 在外环(技能进化)中,技能更新器将历史的探险轨迹分解出局部,可再用的规则更新,经过被搁置的验证,在测试前被冻结. 在这些创新结构设计的推动下,SEAM建立了一个自动化和自发式的评价范式. 4个目标MLLM和10个幻觉类型的实验表明,SEAM的绩效大大高于代表性静态基准,在12个匹配的比较中,平均有效幻觉发现率相对提高了89.2%。

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding and reasoning [ 17 ] , yet they remain prone to hallucinations—fabricating nonexistent objects, misassociating visual content with prior knowledge, or making judgments unsupported by the image [ 14 , 8 , 18 ] . Such failures undermine reliability in deployment and underscore the importance of systematically evaluating MLLM hallucinations [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉理解和推理[17]方面已经取得了显著进展,但它们仍然容易产生幻觉——制造出不存在的物体,将视觉内容与先前的知识错误联系起来,或者使判断不受图像支持[14,8,18]. 这种失败破坏了部署中的可靠性,并突出了系统评估MLLM幻觉的重要性[32].

blocks.en: Existing MLLM hallucination evaluation frameworks largely adopt static evaluation protocols, assessing target models with predefined test items. These items cover diverse hallucination dimensions, including object existence [ 14 ] , attributes [ 32 , 18 ] , complex relations [ 40 , 34 , 6 ] , open-ended generation [ 29 ] , misleading inputs [ 8 , 5 ] , and multi-image consistency [ 12 ] . More recently, LLM-assisted sample generation has further broadened the diversity of evaluation samples [ 18 , 31 , 34 ] . However, evaluation often still relies on fixed test items or generation strategies, without using target-response feedback to refine probes or update reusable construction rules (Fig. 1 (a)). Broader coverage and more diverse samples alone therefore do not guarantee systematic discovery of target-model vulnerabilities. We identify two key limitations. Limitation 1: Entangled probe construction and limited target adaptation. Probe construction involves three distinct components: hallucination types , which define the target failure modes; elicitation strategies , which determine how questions induce or expose these failures; and question formats , which structure probes and expected responses. Embedding these components in monolithic construction rules limits their independent reuse and extension. Structural flexibility alone, however, does not ensure target adaptation: probing also needs target-response feedback to guide refinement when an initial query fails to expose a hallucination. Without such feedback, alternative visual targets or elicitation contexts for the same hallucination type may remain unexplored in the same image (Fig. 1 (a)). Limitation 2: Lack of cross-instance strategy evolution. Even when feedback improves an individual test item, it does not automatically update the construction rules used for subsequent images. Sample generation can broaden test-set diversity, but does not by itself turn probing experience into reusable strategy improvements. Without such updates, ineffective target-selection or question-construction patterns may recur across instances, while successful probing experience remains underused. This motivates distilling historical probing trajectories into reusable rule updates that improve subsequent evaluations.
blocks.zh: 现有的MLLM幻觉评价框架基本上采用静态评价协议,用预先确定的测试项目评估目标模型. 这些项目涵盖不同的幻觉维度,包括物体存在[14],属性[32,18],复杂关系[40,34,6],可自由参加的一代[29],误导性输入[8,5],多图像一致性[12]. 最近,LLM协助的样本生成进一步扩大了评价样本的多样性[18、31、34]。 然而,评价往往仍然依赖于固定的测试项目或生成战略,没有利用目标响应反馈来完善探测器或更新可重复使用的施工规则(图1(a))。 因此,仅仅扩大覆盖面和更多样化的样本并不能保证有系统地发现目标模式的脆弱性。 我们确定了两个关键限制。 限制 1:被缠绕的探测器构造和有限的目标适应. 探测构造涉及三个不同的部分:确定目标故障模式的幻觉类型;确定问题如何诱导或暴露这些故障的诱导策略;以及质疑格式、何种结构探测和预期反应。 将这些组件嵌入到单体构造规则中,限制了它们的独立再利用和扩展. 然而,仅靠结构灵活性并不能确保目标适应:在初始查询未能暴露出幻觉时,探测还需要目标响应反馈来指导完善. 没有这种反馈,同一型号的可选择的视觉目标或诱导环境可能仍未在相同图像中加以探讨(图1(a))。 限制2:缺乏跨机构战略的演变。 即使反馈改善了单个测试项目,它也不会自动更新用于后续图像的构建规则. 样本生成可以拓宽测试集的多样性,但本身并不能将探究经验转化为可重复使用的战略改进. 如果没有这种更新,无效的目标选择或问题构建模式可能会在各种情况下重复出现,而成功的调查经验仍然没有得到充分利用。 这激励了将历史探险轨迹分解为可再用规则更新,以完善后期评价.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose SEAM , a self-evolving and adaptive probing framework for automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation (Fig. 1 (b)). SEAM introduces a Hallucination Probe Construction Library (ten skills, three wrappers, five formats) driving two complementary loops (Fig. 2 ). In the inner loop (adaptive probing) , visual analysis identifies targets to compose test items, subject to hierarchical verification. Verifier feedback repairs invalid items, while target MLLM responses guide the refinement of valid probes failing to elicit hallucinations (e.g., using “white socks” to strengthen false premises in Fig. 1 (b)). In the outer loop (skill evolution) , SEAM distills historical trajectories to update reusable probing rules—preserving core definitions—and freezes the validated library before testing. Together, these loops integrate within-instance adaptation with cross-instance evolution, yielding quality-verified items and a reusable library for systematic evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议设立SEAM,作为自动MLLM幻觉评价的自演和适应性测试框架(图1(b))。 SEAM引入了"幻觉探险"建筑库(10个技能,3个包装,5个格式)来驱动两个互补回路(图2. 在内环(适应性检测)中,视觉分析确定目标来作曲测试项目,接受分级核查. 校验器反馈修复无效物品,而目标MLLM响应则指导改进无法产生幻觉的有效探测器(例如使用"白袜"来强化图1(b)中的假前提). 在外环(技能进化)中,SEAM会分解出历史轨迹来更新可再用检验规则——保留核心定义——并在测试前冻结已验证的库. 这些环路共同将内在适应与跨内向演化相结合,产生质量验证的项目和一个可重复使用的库来进行系统评价.

blocks.en:
Experiments across four target MLLMs and ten hallucination-probing skills show that SEAM raises the average valid hallucination discovery rate (VHDR) from 14.90% to 27.67%, while maintaining automated Quality above 98.1% across all targets. Under matched images, target hallucination types, and equal test-time target-query budgets, SEAM consistently discovers more valid hallucinations than the original questions in POPE [ 14 ] , AMBER [ 32 ] , and PhD [ 18 ] . Human audits further support the reliability of the automated quality verifier and hallucination judge.
Our contributions are fourfold: • We introduce SEAM , a novel self-evolving and adaptive probing framework for systematic and automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation. • We propose an adaptive hallucination probing pipeline and a Hallucination Probe Construction Library, enabling iterative, target-model-in-the-loop evaluation. • We propose an evidence-guided skill evolution mechanism that distills historical probing trajectories into target-specific, validated updates to reusable probing rules, further improving evaluation effectiveness. • We conduct experiments and ablation studies demonstrating SEAM’s effectiveness and reliability as an automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation framework.

我们的贡献有四个方面: 我们介绍SEAM,这是系统、自动的MLLM幻觉评价的自演和适应性测试新框架。 我们提议建立一个适应性幻觉探测管道和一个幻觉探测建筑图书馆,以便进行迭接、目标模型即时评估。 我们提出由证据指导的技能演化机制,将历史探险轨迹提炼成针对特定目标,经过验证的更新,以再利用的探险规则,进一步提高评价效能. 我们进行实验和消毒研究,证明SEAM作为自动MLLM幻觉评价框架的有效性和可靠性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing MLLM hallucination benchmarks have progressed along two complementary axes: expanding taxonomic coverage and scaling sample construction. Along the taxonomic axis, benchmarks probe object existence via binary polling [ 14 ] or audit hallucinated objects, attributes, and relations in captions [ 9 , 32 ] , while diagnostic suites target verb concepts [ 33 ] , entangled visual illusions and language priors [ 8 ] , and rich-context descriptions [ 10 ] . Along the construction axis, recent pipelines scale beyond manual curation via model-assisted prompting [ 18 ] and open-set sample synthesis [ 31 ] . These advances broaden what is tested and how samples are constructed, but do not by themselves enable target-adaptive probe refinement. SEAM builds on these taxonomies and uses target-model responses to guide the refinement of probing content and question framing.
blocks.zh: 现有的MLLM幻觉基准沿着两个互补轴线取得了进展:扩大分类覆盖范围和扩展样本构建. 在分类轴上,基准通过二进制投票[14]或审计在标题[9,32]中的幻觉对象,属性,和关系来探究物体的存在,而诊断套件则针对动词概念[33],缠绕视觉幻觉和语言前传[8],并富于文字描述[10]. 沿着施工轴线上,最近的管线通过模型助推[18]和开放式集成样品合成[31],超出了人工校正的范围. 这些进展拓宽了测试的内容和样品的构造,但本身并不能使目标适应探测器得到完善。 SEAM以这些分类为基础,并使用目标-模型响应来指导测试内容和问题框架的完善.

blocks.en: AutoBencher [ 13 ] casts benchmark construction as an optimization problem, iteratively refining dataset descriptions to generate questions that expose model weaknesses. VLB [ 36 ] dynamically transforms images and questions through vision–language bootstrapping, using a judge to verify consistency and enabling evaluation at varying levels of complexity. KBE-DME [ 39 ] further explores multimodal benchmark evolution through knowledge integration. Complementarily, G-Memory [ 38 ] and ReasoningBank [ 22 ] reuse agent experience through hierarchical memory and distilled reasoning strategies. The distinctive focus of SEAM is to connect validity-constrained probe refinement with the evolution of hallucination-specific construction rules. Verifier feedback repairs invalid probes, while target-response feedback refines valid but unsuccessful ones; the resulting experience is distilled into reusable rules for subsequent images.
blocks.zh: Auto Bencher [13] 将基准构建作为优化问题,迭代地完善数据集描述,以产生暴露模型弱点的问题. VLB[36]通过视觉-语言诱导,利用法官核实一致性,并促成在不同复杂程度的评价,动态地转变图像和问题。 KBE-DME [39] 进一步探索通过知识融合实现多式联运基准的演变. 作为补充,G-Memory[38]和ReasoningBank[22]通过分级内存和分馏推理策略再利用剂体验. SEAM的显著重点是将有效性受限探测器的改进与幻觉特有构造规则的演化联系起来. 校验器反馈修复无效的探测器,而目标响应反馈则精炼出有效但失败的探测器;由此而来的经验被提炼成后续图像的可再用规则.

Guided by this library, the inner-loop Adaptive Hallucination Probing Pipeline (Sec. 3.3 ) matches skills to images, performs skill-guided visual analysis, selects probing targets, constructs candidate test items, and queries ℳ \mathcal{M} only with quality-approved items. It evaluates whether ℳ \mathcal{M} produces hallucinations, refines test items using quality or target-response feedback within K K attempts per instance, and selects the final item through a validity-first rule. Historical probing trajectories from the collection subset drive the outer-loop Evidence-Guided Skill Evolution (Sec. 3.4 ), which converts accumulated experience into local updates to the library’s probing rules. These updates undergo held-out validation, yielding the target-specific skill set 𝒮 ℳ ⋆ \mathcal{S}^{\star}_{\mathcal{M}} , which is frozen before testing. Within-instance adaptive probing and cross-instance skill evolution form a skill-guided, experience-driven hallucination evaluation framework.

blocks.en: 3.3 Adaptive Hallucination Probing Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.3 适应性幻觉探测管

blocks.en: While the library provides composable probing strategies, generating diverse, image-grounded, and effective test items requires skill–image matching, visual evidence grounding, quality control, and target-model feedback. We therefore develop the Adaptive Hallucination Probing Pipeline , integrating four complementary modules: (i) Skill-Guided Visual Analysis matches skills to images and identifies relevant visual evidence; (ii) Hallucination-Eliciting Question Composer generates questions and reference answers; (iii) Hierarchical Question Verifier assesses question quality and provides corrective feedback; and (iv) Failure-Aware Refinement analyzes target-model responses to valid items that fail to elicit confirmed hallucinations and guides subsequent revisions. Both feedback types are routed to the composer for iterative refinement within the inner loop, with at most K K attempts per instance.
blocks.zh: 虽然图书馆提供可调和的检测策略,但生成多样的、以图像为基础的、有效的测试项目需要技能-图像匹配、视觉证据定位、质量控制和目标-模型反馈。 因此,我们开发了适应性幻觉测试管道,整合了四个互补模块:(一) 技能指导视觉分析将技能与图像相匹配并识别出相关的视觉证据;(二) 幻觉-合法问题合成器产生问题和参考答案;(三) 分层问题验证器评估问题质量并提供纠正反馈;(四) 失败-Aware Informination分析对有效项目的目标模型反应,这些有效项目未能被证实产生幻觉并指导随后的修订。 这两种反馈类型都会被路由给作曲家进行内环内迭代完善,最多每个实例都有K K尝试.

blocks.en: The inner loop refines individual test items through feedback, but these instance-level corrections are not directly consolidated into reusable probing strategies, limiting improvements across instances. To bridge this gap, the Skill Updater 𝒰 \mathcal{U} evolves the shared initial library 𝒮 0 \mathcal{S}^{0} independently for each target ℳ \mathcal{M} by distilling its historical probing trajectories into updates to probing rules π s \pi_{s} , while keeping wrappers and formats fixed. This enables accumulated experience to improve subsequent probing strategies without compromising question quality.

blocks.en: We curate 2,000 images from 11 public datasets: MSCOCO [ 15 ] , Visual Genome [ 11 ] , VSR [ 16 ] , TallyQA [ 1 ] , TextVQA [ 27 ] , HICO-DET [ 4 ] , SWiG [ 23 ] , WIT-BASE [ 28 ] , WHOOPS! [ 3 ] , VCR [ 37 ] , and ExDark [ 19 ] . Each image is paired with source annotations and assigned to one of ten probing skills (200 per skill). We partition the images into three disjoint subsets for trajectory collection (400), update validation (400), and final testing (1,200), with 40/40/120 images per skill. All target models share these subsets.

blocks.en: Table 2 compares three SEAM variants across four target MLLMs on the held-out test set, with results grouped by ten probe-construction skills. • Adaptive probing improves test-item validity and hallucination discovery. Compared to w/o Feedback & Evolution ( K = 1 K=1 ), w/o Skill Evolution ( K = 2 K=2 ) raises mean Quality from 74.65% to 97.92% and mean VHDR from 14.90% to 24.33% (gaining 4.50–14.00 points per target). Notable VHDR gains occur in Counting Error (V4), Reasoning Overreach (E1), and Unverifiable Inference (E2). Verifier feedback repairs invalid items, while target responses refine valid but unsuccessful probes, supporting two-attempt adaptation over single-pass generation (Sec. 4.3 assesses budget-matched feedback). • Outer-loop skill evolution improves hallucination discovery while preserving validity. At budget K = 2 K=2 , independently evolving 𝒮 0 \mathcal{S}^{0} into target-specific libraries 𝒮 M ⋆ \mathcal{S}_{M}^{\star} raises mean VHDR from 24.33% to 27.67% (gaining 1.75–6.83 points per target) while maintaining 98.17%–99.17% Quality. The validation gate accepts 8, 5, 7, and 5 skill updates ( † \dagger ) for GPT-5.2, Kimi-K2.5, Gemini-3-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Notable gains occur in Attribute Shift (V2) and Text/OCR Error (V5) on GPT-5.2, Counting Error (V4) on Kimi-K2.5, and Object Insertion (V1) on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Although a few updates yield unchanged or lower skill-wise VHDR, the evolved library improves overall VHDR and Quality across all targets, supporting trajectory-guided evolution on unseen images. Together, instance-level adaptive refinement and cross-instance skill evolution enable SEAM to discover more hallucinations on unseen images while maintaining high test-item validity.

blocks.en: We compare SEAM with POPE, AMBER, and PhD, covering rule-based, human-annotated, and LLM-assisted test construction. For each image, we randomly sample one original benchmark question and generate one SEAM test item targeting the same hallucination type. Both undergo quality verification using the same evaluator: original questions receive reference-answer-related checks, while SEAM items additionally undergo skill, wrapper, format, and diagnostic-quality checks. Rejected items remain in the denominator and contribute zero to VHDR. SEAM uses the evolved, frozen library 𝒮 ℳ ⋆ \mathcal{S}^{\star}_{\mathcal{M}} with K = 1 K=1 , allowing at most one test-time target-model query per image for either method. All responses are evaluated by the same Hallucination Judge. As shown in Fig. 3 , SEAM achieves higher VHDR in all 12 comparisons, with relative improvements of 27.7%–245.5%. The largest relative improvement occurs on POPE for GPT-5.2, where VHDR increases from 11.0% to 38.0%. These results support SEAM’s ability to discover more valid hallucinations under matched images, target hallucination types, and test-time target-query budgets.

blocks.en: • Probe Library Design and Utilization. Under the single-attempt setting ( K = 1 K=1 ), introducing the Probe Library consistently improves both Quality and VHDR across the two target models. Skill-guided analysis provides further gains by extracting task-relevant visual evidence, complementing the broader elicitation coverage provided by the Probe Library. • Feedback-guided Inner-loop Refinement. Under the same two-attempt budget, Feedback Refinement substantially outperforms Independent Best-of-2 in both Quality and VHDR across the two models. This indicates that using diagnostic feedback to guide subsequent attempts is more effective than independently generating candidates. Specifically, verifier feedback helps repair invalid items, while target-response feedback refines valid probes that fail to elicit hallucinations. These complementary signals improve both construction reliability and hallucination discovery. • Evidence-guided Outer-loop Skill Evolution. The final two variants evaluate outer-loop skill updating with test-time feedback refinement ( K = 2 K=2 ), starting from the same initial skill library 𝒮 0 \mathcal{S}^{0} . Both variants prioritize quality corrections during rule consolidation and use the same validation-gated acceptance procedure. They differ in trajectory processing: w/ Direct Skill Update updates probing rules from unpartitioned trajectory batches, whereas SEAM (Ours) first partitions trajectories into three groups—Quality Failure, Valid Miss, and Valid Hit—to guide targeted rule updates. Compared with Direct Skill Update, SEAM improves Quality from 95.67% to 98.00% and VHDR from 29.33% to 32.67% on GPT-5.2, and Quality from 93.67% to 96.33% and VHDR from 21.00% to 23.67% on Kimi-K2.5. These results demonstrate the benefit of explicit trajectory classification for improving hallucination discovery while maintaining test-item validity.

blocks.en: We evaluate three generator backbones against GPT-5.2 on 100 test instances balanced across ten probing skills. Each backbone performs skill-guided visual analysis and question composition using the same frozen evolved skill library, verifier, and judge. All runs use K = 1 K=1 . The default Qwen3.6-Plus, Claude Opus 5.5 [ 2 ] , and the smaller Qwen3.5-4B [ 24 ] achieve VHDRs of 28.0%, 43.0%, and 21.0%, respectively. These results demonstrate SEAM’s compatibility with different generator backbones, allowing users to choose models according to application needs.

blocks.en: 4.4 Evaluator Reliability and Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 评价者可靠性和定性分析

blocks.en: We sampled 300 test items from each of the three SEAM variants ( w/o Feedback & Evolution , w/o Skill Evolution , and SEAM (Ours) ) evaluated against GPT-5.2, with 30 items per probing skill and 900 items in total. Two annotators independently reviewed the items, with final human labels serving as references. The Hierarchical Question Verifier achieves 94.0% accuracy and 95.1% precision among approved items. We also manually evaluated 817 GPT-5.2 responses to approved items (230, 293, and 294 across the three variants, respectively). The GPT-6.1-Sol-based Hallucination Judge achieves 97.4% precision and 97.8% recall, treating hallucination as the positive class. These results indicate that most approved probes satisfy human-assessed validity criteria and that the judge closely agrees with human hallucination labels.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented SEAM , a self-evolving and adaptive probing framework for automatic MLLM hallucination evaluation. Rather than relying on one-shot question generation, SEAM introduces a manually curated, composable Hallucination Probe Construction Library that separates what to probe, how to elicit, and how to formulate. Building on this foundation, its inner loop integrates visual analysis, question composition, hierarchical quality verification, and target-model feedback for adaptive test-item refinement. Its outer loop addresses the limitation of instance-level corrections by distilling historical probing trajectories into target-specific, validated, and reusable probing strategies. By connecting instance-level adaptation with cross-instance skill evolution, SEAM provides a systematic and extensible approach to hallucination evaluation. Experiments and human audits confirm SEAM’s effectiveness and reliability.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了SEAM, 一个自动MLLM幻觉评估的自我演变和适应性的测试框架。 SEAM不依靠一发式的问题生成,而是引入了手动编程的可调谐的"幻觉探险"(Callucination Probe Construction Library),该图书馆将探测的是什么,如何被引出,如何被制定. 在此基础上,其内环融合了视觉分析,质疑组成,分级质量核查,以及适应性测试项目完善的目标模型反馈. 其外环通过将历史探险轨迹分解成特定目标,验证和可再用探险策略来解决实例级校正的限制. 通过将实例层面的适应与跨实例技能演化联系起来,SEAM为幻觉评价提供了系统而可扩展的方法. 实验和人的审计证实了SEAM的有效性和可靠性.
